scenes.audio: What if you were raised by the world's most dangerous tribe?
scenes.visual: Pale skeletal humanoid with large bulging eyes, translucent skin, brown loincloth, running forward in lush jungle; bright light filtered through canopy; low camera moving with subject (tracking).

scenes.audio: Day one: you are dragged through dense jungle,
scenes.visual: Same creature running through dense jungle; camera follows from low angle; filtered sunlight.

scenes.audio: past warning signs carved into trees,
scenes.visual: Creature climbs large trunk carved with skull-and-crossbones and strange symbols; close on pale skeletal hand gripping tree.

scenes.audio: while elders decide if you are worth feeding.
scenes.visual: Creature in clearing surrounded by torch-holding tribal people of various ages; creature holds large colorful swirl lollipop; warm torchlight.

scenes.audio: That night, you are left alone near the fire,
scenes.visual: Creature sits by small campfire at night; warm light on skeletal body; dark woods; floating sparks.

scenes.audio: knowing sunrise is not guaranteed.
scenes.visual: Creature by campfire looking up and away; warm light, dark background, sparks.

scenes.audio: Year three: you are taken on your first hunt,
scenes.visual: Creature, slightly older, brown tunic, runs across grassy savanna; tribal hunters with spears behind; sunset orange glow.

scenes.audio: not to participate, but to watch what happens when someone slows everyone down.
scenes.visual: Creature runs alongside hunters chasing an animal; low-angle following camera; bright warm light.

scenes.audio: When the animal fights back, you are ordered to finish it.
scenes.visual: Creature in front of tribe holding primitive stone knife; serious expression; cloudy sky, tribal silhouettes.

scenes.audio: Hands shaking, blade slipping,
scenes.visual: Creature in dry desert-like setting holding stone knife with both hands, hands shaking; camera close on face and hands.

scenes.audio: learning what hesitation costs.
scenes.visual: Creature in grassy field holding stone knife; close on determined face; soft light, green field.

scenes.audio: Year ten: raids become routine,
scenes.visual: Creature, older, heavier fur garment, stands in dark woods holding primitive club; low light.

scenes.audio: crossing into rival territory under cover of darkness, moving silently through mud and rain.
scenes.visual: Creature from behind moving through foggy jungle with tribal figures in distance; holds spear; dim, fog.

scenes.audio: You carry weapons now,
scenes.visual: Creature from behind walking through dark foggy forest; same fur garment; tall dark trees.

scenes.audio: you are expected to use them,
scenes.visual: Creature runs through forest in storm; lightning flashes; carries club; camera follows movement.

scenes.audio: and when someone charges you, your body reacts before fear can surface.
scenes.visual: Creature in rain, club raised overhead to strike; rain and lightning highlights; intense expression.

scenes.audio: [SFX: water splash, no narration]
scenes.visual: Creature strikes club down into water; large splash; dim, dark.

scenes.audio: Year fifteen: a rival tests you openly,
scenes.visual: Creature now large muscular adult, white skeletal look, leather and fur armor, stands in torch-lit arena; tribal crowd; stoic.

scenes.audio: stepping too close, breaking rules,
scenes.visual: Creature mid-fight in arena throwing punch at large muscular man; crowd cheering; torchlight.

scenes.audio: daring you to respond in front of everyone.
scenes.visual: Creature finishes fight, foot on defeated opponent; crowd behind; warm dramatic light.

scenes.audio: The fight is fast, brutal, and decisive,
scenes.visual: Creature kneels over defeated opponent, hands near opponent's head; crowd blurred; warm focused light.

scenes.audio: and when it ends, no one intervenes or speaks your name again.
scenes.visual: Creature stands in arena looking forward, serious; silent crowd; torchlight; arena structures.

scenes.audio: Year twenty: armed men arrive suddenly, shouting orders and pointing rifles at the village.
scenes.visual: Creature (muscular adult) in village with straw-roofed huts; men in modern military clothing with rifles behind; creature raises hands; bright sunny light.

scenes.audio: When one grabs a child, you attack without thinking,
scenes.visual: Creature runs forward with bone club; behind, a child held by a soldier; village on fire; orange flame glow.

scenes.audio: doing exactly what you were trained to do.
scenes.visual: Creature grapples armed man, hand on his throat; fire and smoke behind.

scenes.audio: By the time the shooting stops, they understand you were never the one who needed saving.
scenes.visual: Creature stands in burning village holding bone club, child behind it; armed men in background, some on ground; smoke.

scenes.audio: [Music builds then fades, no narration]
scenes.visual: Creature in village square surrounded by tribe and defeated armed men; young tribal girl beside it holding colorful swirl lollipop; bright light.
